method: Manifold mesh reconstruction from saved FeatureScript geometry
target: General FDM, 0.4 mm nozzle, single material then paint

functor-plaque-complete.stl.print_note: Assembled one-piece version. Upright orientation; supports needed for relief overhangs. The two-piece option is easier to print.

plaque-two-piece/01-panel-flat.stl.print_note: Recommended plaque face. Print as oriented, artwork upward; no supports.

plaque-two-piece/02-stand.stl.print_note: Print flat as oriented, slot upward, no supports. Glue panel into slot after painting; mask joint surfaces.

functor-sculpture-complete.stl.print_note: Print upright on the broad base. Supports are required under the torus, sign and other overhangs. Use a bed larger than 218 x 144 mm and >202 mm Z capacity.

print_adjustments: Raised artwork outlines have a 0.01 mm outward offset to join point-touching pixel details and prevent non-manifold STL seams.
Coincident relief/backing interfaces overlap internally by 0.02 mm before Boolean fusion, with no change to external dimensions.
Plaque two-piece stand recess has 0.25 mm clearance per side for fitting and glue.
All main STLs are fused into one connected closed solid; colors are intentionally omitted for painting.
Curved sections are tessellated to approximately 0.015 mm chordal deviation; binary STL round-trip is validated.
